## Added
- Search like on Spotify: top result, songs, artist, album and playlist rows, filters, recent searches and browse tiles. It also searches the public Deezer catalog, those songs play as the official 30 second preview
- Spotify login in the browser: tap Connect, confirm on Spotify's own page, done. The server keeps and renews the login, so it stays connected on all your devices
- Spotify playlists import fully: names, artists, cover, description, owner and length come from Spotify, playback runs through YouTube (needs a YouTube API key in Settings). A progress bar shows what is being imported
- Imported playlists look like on Spotify: big cover, description, owner, likes and total length
- Settings rebuilt as a full page with a search field, quick jumps and clear cards instead of the long side panel
- Update button in every app: Settings → Updates shows the server and app versions and updates them with one tap (server for admins, Android app, Windows and Linux app). The apps point out new versions once a day
- Proxmox installer: says up front whether it is a clean install or an update, tells you when something has to be done in Tailscale (switch on HTTPS) instead of waiting silently, and writes an overview with version and addresses into the container's notes
- Visualizer in the full-screen player: bars, ring and wave, driven by the real audio (browser and desktop via WebAudio, Android via the system visualizer). Tap the visualizer button to switch, or pick a style in Settings
- Android: the equalizer now works in the app too
- Everything starts in English. Pick Deutsch once and it stays: after reloads, updates and on your other devices (saved with your account)
- The installer asks whether to set up Tailscale for listening away from home, with a short explanation
- Website: full documentation under Docs, a Web player button that opens your own server, a tidier menu with two categories, and a livelier listening room with smooth light and colour changes, many more camera shots and a proper speaker

## Fixed
- Copy buttons (e.g. the Tailscale address) work in the apps and over http
- The apps start dark, no white flash before the first page
- Website: the install commands no longer trigger a clipboard warning in ad blockers, and long commands wrap instead of running out of their box
- Website: the screenshots in the player gallery are centred again
- The settings button is a real gear
- The server and the web app report their real version instead of 1.0.0

## Install
- **Update server (Proxmox node shell):** `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/proxmox.sh)"`
- **Update server (Debian / Ubuntu):** `musik-update`
- **Android:** install the new `Musik.apk` over the old one
- **Windows:** run the new `Musik.exe`
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
- **From now on:** Settings → Updates → Update now. Run the Proxmox script or `musik-update` once so the server may update itself
